description: Amsterdam: Eerste Helmersstraat also carries alt_name 1e Helmersstraat, so the number token 1 reads the street twice: as the street through 'helmersstraat 1e' (no unmatched word, 1e found) and as its house through 'eerste' (one unmatched word). Comparing unmatched words first (a0e8fd312f) gave 1 the street atom, 102 1/2 was not read as one house number and the query fell apart into 1-2 Derde Helmersstraat + the tram stop 1e C. Huygensstraat. These atoms exist only with the common words of the full map: eerste, tweede and helmersstraat are not common there and 1e is. A small extract puts eerste, tweede and helmersstraat into the top 10 frequent words and both versions behave the same, so the extract also carries the named streets of central Amsterdam (without Eerste/Tweede/Derde/Helmers names, two nodes each) that fill the top 10 with van, de, nieuwe, jan, korte.
